thread:
ana li: Heads up — candidate offer for Senior Infra Eng (EMEA) needs a one-off compband uplift and an early start. We're blocked on tax withholding guidance and whether to frontload first month benefits. Full snippet below.

ana li: Offer details:
```
Base: GBP 120,000
Sign-on: GBP 10,000 (one-time)
Requested start: 2026-04-06 (earlier than payroll window)
Compband: requested uplift to Band 5D -> 5E provisional for 6 months
Location: UK (contracted via Redwood UK LLP)
```

jamal singh: Thanks Ana. Two quick asks: 1) Is this candidate visa-sponsored? 2) Do we intend to backdate benefits eligibility to start date if payroll can't be onboarded until 04/15?

ana li: Not visa-sponsored, local hire. Hiring manager wants benefits active from first day — they argued retention risk. Payroll told me payroll cutoff is 04/15.

marta rodriguez: If payroll can't do 04/06, we normally do a provisional stipendiary payment and mark benefits pending. For compband uplifts that are provisional we need approval from comp committee + finance signoff. Do we have manager approval for temporary uplift?

ana li: Manager (kevin) confirmed verbally and copied here. Kevin, can you confirm in thread?

kevin cho: Confirmed. Manager approves provisional uplift for 6 months and will commit to retention review at month 5. Also OK with sign-on being paid in full on first payroll available.

people-ops-bot: Routing to comp-committee for "Provisional Uplift" review. Please include justification doc link and manager note.

jamal singh: Tagging finance: @marta please confirm if a provisional payroll top-up + benefits frontload is feasible as an exception (we'll need a GL code and one-off tax withholding calc). Also, we should flag any UK employer NI implications.

marta rodriguez: Quick summary of what comp committee will need:
- Manager justification (retention risk, market comp)
- Proposed rollback plan (6 months + review)
- Payroll timing constraint and proposed make-whole (gross-up? holdback?)
- Tax/NI impact note from finance

ana li: I've uploaded the manager justification here: https://redwood.share/people-ops/docs/offer-justification-4198765432 (private).

kevin cho: Adding retention clause to offer and ok to do rollback at month 6 if performance/benchmarks not met.

jamal singh: OK — I'll work with finance to draft the tax note. If comp committee approves we can route to legal to finalize wording for the offer amendment. ETA for comp committee review?

marta rodriguez: We can triage this in tomorrow's comp meeting (04/02). If we get approval, payroll can schedule provisional payment on 04/15 and benefits can be backdated to 04/06 provided HR confirms enrollment paperwork is completed before payroll cutoff.

ana li: Thanks team. Will prep a 1-pager and ping comp committee. :thumbsup:

kevin cho: Appreciate it. Candidate is hoping for clarity by EOD Friday.

people-ops-bot: Action items logged: [Ana] prepare 1-pager + link, [Jamal] tax note, [Marta] confirm GL code + NI calc, [Comp Committee] decision 04/02.
